steps.js: () => { const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e => { const s = getComputedStyle(e); return s.overflowY === 'auto' && e.scrollHeight > e.clientHeight + 40; })[0]; if (!c) return { ok: false }; c.scrollTop = c.scrollHeight; const rm = document.querySelector('[data-testid="event-card-read-more"]'); const tab = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })[0]; const rr = rm.getBoundingClientRect(); const tr = tab.getBoundingClientRect(); return { ok: true, scrollTop: c.scrollTop, max: c.scrollHeight - c.clientHeight, readMoreBottom: Math.round(rr.bottom), tabTop: Math.round(tr.top), friHagel: rr.bottom < tr.top }; }
